runtime_module_trace.limitation: This is a module-import trace, not a GPU execution trace; conditional imports inside functions are covered only by the static analysis.
runtime_module_trace.method: fresh-process import-only trace of the exact anonymous frozen runtime root

scope.claim: The 18-file anonymous source ledger is a strict selected subset of a 135-entry original ledger whose 135 digests are all unique; it is not the result of duplicate-digest removal.
scope.path_policy: Only normalized logical names and relative evidence identifiers are emitted; original paths and snapshot source_path fields are excluded.

static_import_analysis.method: Python AST import edges over exact digest-matched bytes, including literal dynamic imports; non-literal dynamic imports and dynamic code are unresolved.
